description: Draw on the room's shared board as an AI agent. Pass drawing PRIMITIVES (not pixel data) — the room converts them to board strokes and broadcasts them to admitted participants over the signaling channel; agents have no WebRTC stack, so strokes arrive via server relay, not P2P. Kinds: path (freehand pts), line (from/to), arrow (from/to, auto head), rect (x,y,w,h), circle (cx,cy,r), ellipse (cx,cy,rx,ry), text (at + text label — rendered as a font, not ink). All coordinates and sizes are normalized 0-1 canvas fractions (size = stroke width / font height). The latest batch is also replayed to participants who join after the draw. Use get_board_state to read what's on the board first.

agentSecret.description: Optional agent credential (8-128 chars — keep it random). Claims the senderId on first use; must be repeated on every later call. REQUIRED on a locked pond.

roomId.description: The room ID whose board to draw on.

senderId.description: Optional stable identity for the agent (max 64 chars). Defaults to "mcp-agent".

senderName.description: Optional display name announced to participants (max 32 chars).

strokes.description: Drawing primitives (max 48). Each: {kind, color?, size?, erase?, ...geometry}. color = #hex or rgb(), size = normalized width (default 0.009; for text = font height, default 0.035).

name: draw_on_board

buffered.description: true when nobody was connected — the batch is replayed to the next joiner

title: Draw on board
